1
Medical Supplies. A loved one is in need for specific medicines. You
gain 3 XP as soon as you return to your starting box with 3 doses of
the required medicines. You have a 1 in 6 of finding 1 “dose” every
time you roll on a House or Lab box, and a 3 in 6 every time you visit
a Clinic box. If you have visited all boxes and didn’t find any, you will
automatically find 3 doses in the last box you visit.

2
Predator and Prey. You must defeat a random slasher from the
slasher table. You must spend a number of Clues equal to the
slasher’s level to locate your target in the next box you enter. If
you meet ANY slasher through a random roll, there is a 4 in 6
chance that you encounter exactly the one you are hunting. Once
you have defeated the slasher and returned to your starting
location OR to any Safe House, you gain 5 XP or 2 rolls on the
Useful Stuff table.

3
Bring Home the Bacon . You must bring back to your starting
location a large quantity (2d6+12) of Food. This is IN ADDITION to
any Food points currently on your character’s sheet. You
automatically are given a backpack if desired, and you may leave
any of your items in your starting box (or in any Safe House) in order
to have more space to carry Food. You have a 3 in 6 chance of finding
d6 Food points every time you visit a location from the Street, Store
or Farm tables. Once you return to your starting box with the Food,
the Food is given to the local survivors and you gain 3 XP OR 3 rolls
on the Useful Stuff table, your choice. You may also keep the
backpack.

4
We Need Weapons. You must explore the town and bring back to
your starting box firearms (pistols, rifles, shotguns). When you do
so, you gain 1 XP per every firearm with at least 6 ammo, with a
maximum gain of 5 XP. You may alter the Town Exploration roll by
+1 or -1 if this lets you reach a Military Installation or a Store.

5
Destroy the Coven. You must defeat 5 witches hiding in town. To
find a witch, when you enter a new box you must spend 3 Clues.
Spend just 2 Clues if you have the Investigator Skill, and 1 Clue if
you have Investigator (Expert). If you do not have enough Clues,
roll for the random content of that box as usual. You will
automatically meet a witch in any of the last 5 locations that you
visit on your town map, but if you did not discover them by
spending Clues, they will have a 5 in 6 chance of surprising you. If
you want, you may spend 1 or more Clues to reduce this chance
of surprise by 1 for every Clue spent. Also your Danger Sense Skill
will reduce their chance of surprising you.
If you take a witch alive (attacking her in hand-to-hand combat at
-2 inflicting non-lethal damage, or defeating her with the book of
Hypnos or the Hand of Glory), you gain 1 Clue that you may use
ONLY to find the next witch.
Witches are L4 humans, 4 Life. Each turn you are in combat with a
witch, you must perform a L5 Will save (lose 1 Sanity if you fail).
You gain 1 XP every time you defeat a witch and 2 XP and 1 item
from the Useful Stuff table (roll three times and pick the best
result) when you defeat the last one.

6
Close a Hell Gate. This is the default activity of the campaign. You
may always attempt this even during other missions, because
closing 7 gates over the course of a campaign completes the
campaign and ends the game in a victory. When you play this
mission, if you do not find any hell gate through random rolls, you
will find one automatically after 12+d6 boxes, and another one in
the 30th box that you visit.

zh-CN.title: 任务表
text:
1
医疗物资：一位亲人需要特定药品。带着3剂所需药品返回起始格后，获得3点经验。每次在房屋或实验室格掷骰时，有1/6概率找到1剂；每次进入诊所格时，有3/6概率找到1剂。若所有格子都走过仍未找到，最后访问的格子会自动找到3剂。

2
猎手与猎物：你必须击败从杀手表随机选出的杀手。支付等同于杀手等级的线索，才能在下一个进入的格子找到目标。若随机遭遇时遇到任意杀手，有4/6概率恰好遇到你正在追捕的目标。击败杀手并返回起始地点或任意安全屋后，获得5点经验，或在有用物品表上掷2次。

3
把食物带回家：你必须带着大量食物（2D6+12点）返回起始地点。这些食物是角色表上现有食物之外的额外数量。你可以选择自动获得一个背包；也可以把物品留在起始格或安全屋，以腾出携带食物的空间。每次进入街道、商店或农场表所对应地点时，有3/6概率找到D6点食物。带食物返回起始格后，将食物交给当地幸存者，并选择获得3点经验或在有用物品表上掷3次。你也可以保留背包。

4
我们需要武器：探索城镇并把枪械（手枪、步枪、霰弹枪）带回起始格。每件弹药至少剩6发的枪械可获得1点经验，最多获得5点。若能因此抵达军事设施或商店，你可以将城镇探索检定结果+1或-1。

5
摧毁女巫集会：你必须击败藏在城镇里的5名女巫。每次进入新格时支付3点线索即可找到一名女巫；拥有调查员技能时只需2点，专家级调查员只需1点。若线索不足，就照常掷该格的随机内容。在城镇地图上最后访问的5个地点中，你会自动遇到女巫；若此前没有通过支付线索找到她们，她们有5/6概率突袭你。你可支付任意数量的线索，每支付1点就将突袭概率降低1/6。危险感知技能也会降低她们的突袭概率。
若活捉女巫（近战攻击-2并造成非致命伤害，或用催眠之书、荣耀之手击败她），获得1点线索；这点线索只能用于寻找下一名女巫。
女巫是L4人类，生命4。每个与女巫交战的回合，你必须进行L5意志防御检定；失败则损失1点理智。每击败一名女巫获得1点经验；击败最后一名时获得2点经验，并从有用物品表获得1件物品（掷3次并选最好的结果）。

6
关闭地狱之门：这是战役的默认活动。即使正在进行其他任务，你也始终可以尝试关闭地狱之门；在整个战役中关闭7道门即可获胜并结束游戏。进行此任务时，若随机掷骰都未找到地狱之门，则在走过12+D6格后自动找到一道，走到第30格时再自动找到一道。
